_about: Values the app showed on screen in each app screenshot of man/figures, as the screens print them, kept as a record beside the PNGs; no page reads this file. Each value was read from the page text of the running app after the clicks of tools/app_shots.mjs, run by tools/site_figures.R. app_version names the installed versions the shots were taken with. headline gives the sentence under the coverage share, which R/coverage.R sets in headline_meaning, with the number of places the screenshot prints it. Update this file whenever the shots are retaken.
